root.label: Brendan Sorsby leaves Texas Tech amid NCAA investigation

events.label: Brendan Sorsby leaves Texas Tech amid NCAA investigation

slots.name: roster status
slots.sentence: Castellanos joined the Red Raiders after Joey McGuire's program needed a backup following the parting ways between the Red Raiders and Brendan Sorsby, who transferred to Texas Tech this offseason to be the starting quarterback but left the program after being under investigation by the NCAA for a previous gambling addiction.
